missing_evidence.source: Closed-loop counterfactual replay / full backend replay / causal attribution capability

recommendations.rationale: The executed 10 ms probe shows a local difference between the recorded applied input and an instantaneous braking-box input, but objective weighting, seed/shallow-iterate plan selection, effective-horizon effects and projected-GVS-versus-backend model mismatch all remain confounded and the probe cannot arbitrate between them; recorded weight magnitudes alone do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions and scaling. No controller parameter, weight or horizon change is justified.

No further numerical check is authorized in this workflow, and a second projected-state comparison at another update would face the same confound set (weighting, seed selection, horizon, projected-model mismatch) and the same impossibility of explaining a 0.05 s closed-loop settling miss from a bounded local probe.

Before any causal statement about the residual late-window tip speed and position error, obtain the unread coverage named in the gap declarations: backend motion before about t=0.30 s (including per-update force_limit_saturated, tension_tracking_error_n and plan_source), one-step predictions for updates 0-18, and saved projected states other than update 30's; historical optimizer iterations and full warm plans are not retained at all, and no closed-loop replay capability exists.

attribution.reason: From the identical saved projected state and horizon, the held recorded-input rollout's projected endpoint tip speed is 1.26720 m/s and keeps climbing from 0.78274 m/s, while the braking-box rollout reverses tip-velocity direction by t=0.004 s and ends with total displacement 0.00621 m against 0.00867 m already reached by the recorded rollout at t=0.008 s; the differences are far larger than the reported step residuals (about 1e-11 to 1e-13). This supports only a nonzero local 10 ms endpoint difference between the two inputs; it is not evidence about closed-loop settling and identifies no settling cause.

The probe's two rollouts are not identical to numerical resolution: braking-box total tip displacement 0.00621 m versus 0.00867 m reached by the recorded rollout at t=0.008 s, plus a tip-velocity direction reversal at t=0.004 s. The corresponding check hypothesis (endpoint speeds differing by no more than numerical resolution) is contradicted for this saved state and horizon, so the recorded applied tension is not simply the local braking-box solution at update 30.

The probe is flagged advisory_only, is applicable only to instantaneous affine-input acceleration at a fixed recorded pose/rate over 0.01 s, and its capability declaration lists causal_identification and historical_unrecorded_horizons as unsupported. Sampled late-window measured tip speeds stay at 0.22577-1.32948 m/s against a 0.02 m/s scale with projection residuals 0.66-2.92 rad/m and predicted-versus-measured velocity difference norms about 0.022-0.030 m/s, so objective weighting, seed/shallow-iterate plan selection, effective-horizon effects and projected-model mismatch remain mutually confounded, and no closed-loop counterfactual replay exists.

The run records deadline_misses=35 against a 0.01 s control period with stopping_counts User_Requested_Stop=34 and Solve_Succeeded=1, sampled optimization_solve_s about 15.56-15.64 s, sampled update_wall_s about 18.06-18.46 s, and sampled selections at iteration 0 with policy_stop_reason budget_best_feasible (update 33 selected iteration 64) while one sampled plan was accepted. That is consistent with plans being seed/shallow iterates, but selected-iteration coverage is incomplete across the run, the probe neither confirms nor refutes plan convergence, and no closed-loop counterfactual replay exists.

Recorded weights pair terminal_weight 5.0 and tracking_weight 1.0 against velocity_weight 0.0001, terminal_velocity_weight 0.0001 and terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 while terminal reach was met (terminal_error_m 0.00764 m, terminal_speed_m_s 0.63517 m/s), and the executed probe shows the recorded input's projected tip speed rising over 10 ms rather than falling. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions and scaling, and one execution cannot separate weighting from seed selection, horizon effects or projected-model mismatch.

Per-update projection residuals of 0.66432-2.91690 rad/m and predicted-versus-measured tip velocity difference norms of 0.02232-0.02986 m/s show the projected GVS model and the serial backend endpoint disagree locally, and the probe itself predicts, from the same recorded input, a tip speed of 1.26720 m/s at 0.31 s. Whether that local mismatch degrades plan quality cannot be separated from objective weighting, seed selection or horizon effects with the retained views, and no full backend replay is available to quantify it over the settling window.

The probe reports force margins and input-bounds-satisfied flags in its own bounded analytic braking computation, but per-update force_limit_saturated and tension_tracking_error_n signals were not displayed in this context, so a saturation-driven loss of braking authority in the executed plan is neither supported nor excluded here.

The retained records show deadline_misses=35 with sampled update wall times of about 18 s against a 0.01 s control period; no retained observation ties these host-side wall-clock misses to a physical actuation or feedback delay in the simulated plant, and such a delay is not inferred here.

facts.statement: The authorized bounded saved-state probe executed at controller update 30 (time_s 0.3 s; model.gvs@1.0.0, horizon 0.01 s, implicit Euler at 0.002 s) and returned two analytic rollouts from the same saved projected state: row 0 labelled recorded_applied and row 1 the instantaneous braking-box solution. Both start from the same saved state (row-0 start position [0.25087, 0.04832, 0.22330] m; start speed 0.78274 m/s with tip velocity [0.76103, 0.00947, -0.18283] m/s). Under the held recorded applied tension the projected tip speed rises over the horizon (1.13248 m/s at t=0.006 s, 1.26720 m/s at t=0.010 s), i.e. away from the recorded 0.02 m/s tip-speed scale rather than toward it. Under the instantaneous braking-box input the tip velocity at t=0.004 s points in a different direction ([-0.11330, -0.42560, 0.11987] m/s) and total tip displacement over 0.01 s is 0.00621 m with endpoint error 0.05536 m, while the recorded-input rollout had already displaced 0.00867 m by t=0.008 s. The row-1 trajectory step residuals are about 1e-11 to 1e-12, and the record marks the probe advisory_only with applicability 'instantaneous affine-input acceleration at fixed recorded pose/rate'.

The executed probe is bounded and non-causal by construction: it is flagged advisory_only, its applicability is restricted to instantaneous affine-input acceleration at a fixed recorded pose/rate, the run summary limitations state that single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause, and the accompanying capability declaration lists causal_identification and historical_unrecorded_horizons as unsupported. It therefore cannot establish why the sampled settling window was missed.

Sampled late-window measured tip speeds stay far above the recorded 0.02 m/s settling scale: measured_speed_m_s 0.22577 (update 27), 0.29150 (update 23), 0.31390 (update 22), 0.86187 (update 29) and 1.32948 (update 30, endpoint 0.31 s), with late_motion speed 0.86187 m/s at t=0.30 s; predicted-versus-measured tip velocity difference norms are 0.02232 m/s (update 27) and 0.02986 m/s (update 19), and per-update projection residuals are 0.66432 rad/m (update 9), 1.91927 rad/m (update 21) and 2.91690 rad/m (update 32).

Summary reports reach_passed=true with terminal_error_m=0.00764 m inside reach_tolerance_m=0.01 m, while sampled_settling_passed=false: late_max_error_m=0.05814 m against the recorded settling position_limit_m=0.01 m over the recorded 0.05 s settling window, and terminal_speed_m_s=0.63517 m/s at the end of the sampled record.

The run records deadline_misses=35 with stopping_counts User_Requested_Stop=34 and Solve_Succeeded=1 against control_period_s=0.01 and max_iterations=120; sampled optimization_solve_s is 15.63853 s (update 0) and 15.56360 s (update 17), and sampled update_wall_s is 18.46320 s (update 4) and 18.05667 s (update 25); sampled selections include optimization_selected_iteration=0 with policy_stop_reason=budget_best_feasible (updates 19 and 27), optimization_raw_status=User_Requested_Stop (update 27), plan_accepted=true (update 20) and selected iteration 64 for update 33, while sampled effective horizons are 10 control intervals (updates 8, 13, 20, 23, 24) and 1 control interval for update 34.

For sampled intervals the applied input equals the requested input (applied_input_difference_n=0.0 N at updates 21, 24, 28 and 30), and the applied tension vector repeats an identical value across updates 25 and 32's neighbours while updates 29 (largest component 7.02294 N) and 32 differ; the recorded recipe weights are tracking_weight 1.0, terminal_weight 5.0, velocity_weight 0.0001, terminal_velocity_weight 0.0001, terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 and seed_speed_limit_m_s 0.02 against tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02.

limitations: The executed probe is a 10 ms projected-model endpoint comparison at one saved projected state from a recorded pose/rate; it cannot explain the whole settling failure (late_max_error_m 0.05814 m against a 0.01 m limit with sampled tip speeds of 0.22577-1.32948 m/s against a 0.02 m/s scale), is not a braking or closed-loop claim, and does not establish any dominant cause.

Objective weighting, seed/shallow-iterate plan selection, effective-horizon effects and projected-GVS-versus-backend model mismatch remain mutually confounded for any 10 ms endpoint difference; unsupported capabilities include causal_identification and historical_unrecorded_horizons.

Historical optimizer iterations and full warm plans are not retained (control_snapshots.json, full_snapshots_available=false), and no closed-loop counterfactual replay or full backend replay capability exists, so plan convergence and closed-loop causality remain indeterminate.

Unread in this context: backend motion before about t=0.30 s (including per-update force_limit_saturated and tension_tracking_error_n), one-step predictions for updates 0-18, and saved projected states other than update 30's; no further numerical check is authorized.
recommended_actions: Defer any controller parameter, weight or horizon change: the probe shows a local input difference but cannot separate objective weighting, seed/shallow-iterate selection, effective-horizon effects and projected-model mismatch, and raw weight magnitudes alone do not establish cost-term importance.
Do not run further numerical checks in this workflow: a second bounded projected-state comparison would face the same confound set and could not explain the 0.05 s closed-loop settling miss.

Before any causal statement, obtain the unread coverage (backend motion before about t=0.30 s including saturation and tension-tracking signals, one-step predictions for updates 0-18, saved projected states other than update 30's); historical optimizer iterations and full warm plans are not retained, and no closed-loop replay capability exists.
